description: This file contains unit tests for the DataElement and LinkedDataElement classes in the Thunder project, utilizing Google Test framework. It tests functionality such as copying, size management, CRC calculation, search, and buffer manipulations for data elements.

classes.name: DataElement
classes.description: A class representing a data element that manages a buffer and associated operations like copy, resize, CRC, and search.

classes.name: LinkedDataElement
classes.description: A class representing a linked data element that can be enclosed with other linked elements, providing buffer management and association features.

classes.name: DataElementParser
classes.description: A parser class for DataElement objects, enabling validation and byte skipping during data analysis.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies data into the DataElement buffer or from one DataElement to another.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Gets or sets the size of the DataElement.

methods.name: CRC32
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum of the data buffer.

methods.name: SearchNumber
methods.description: Searches for a number in the DataElement buffer with specified endianness.

methods.name: SetNumber
methods.description: Sets a number value in the DataElement with specified endianness.

methods.name: GetNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a number value from the DataElement with specified endianness.

methods.name: Search
methods.description: Performs a search within the DataElement buffer.

methods.name: SetBitNumber
methods.description: Sets bits within the DataElement buffer.

methods.name: GetBitNumber
methods.description: Retrieves bits from the DataElement buffer.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets a byte value at a specific offset in the DataElement buffer.

methods.name: Align
methods.description: Aligns the DataElement buffer to a specific boundary.

methods.name: Enclosed
methods.description: Gets or sets the enclosed LinkedDataElement in linked data structures.

methods.name: LinkedSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the linked elements.

methods.name: LinkedElements
methods.description: Returns the number of linked elements.
